name: TRIPS
aliases: TRIPS: Neural Feature Attachment and Pyramid Rendering for 3DGS
definition: A point-based radiance field rendering technique that rasterizes points into a screen-space image pyramid using trilinear splats, followed by a neural reconstruction network to produce hole-free, crisp images.
summary: TRIPS is a point-based radiance field technique that rasterizes points into a screen-space image pyramid using trilinear splats and neural reconstruction to produce hole-free, crisp images.
